name: text-telop-shiver
title: Shaking Telop
description: Chữ telop viền màu đứng giữa khung nhưng từng chữ cái run lệch và xoay nhẹ liên tục theo nhịp riêng, các chữ cạnh nhau hơi giống nhau, như đang run sợ hay phấn khích.

moworks.author: takayu

options.rate: noise units a second (10), sampled at 24 fps
options.phase: noise offset between neighbours (2.59: about 30 % alike)

credit.author: TakayuStudio (motion-reference)
credit.licence: No licence stated: idea and numbers only
credit.madeNote: written here from the idea and its numbers; none of the source's code

moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio tx-telop-shake, written here): Per char, updated on a 24 fps grid: x, y offset (±3 px, recipe 2–6) and rotation (±3°) from smooth value noise running at 10 units / s; neighbours' noise phases differ by 0.7 × 3.7 units (≈30 % correlation). Telop style: heavy text (spacing 0.03 em), ink fill, second-accent outer stroke 0.3 em, dark offset (2, 2) px shadow. Fades in 0.3–0.42 s, off at 2.7 s. Loop 3 s. Params: độ lệch (±3 px) · độ xoay (±3°) · nhịp nhiễu (10 / s, cập nhật 24 fps) · tương quan (30 %).
